blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Bryan Bagunas and the Alas Pilipinas men were overwhelmed by the show of support from the Philippine volleyball community after he called out the lack of support ahead of the Asian Games, vowing to stay focused despite the team’s on- and off-court struggles. Bagunas scored 15 points again and led Alas’ gallant stand in the first two sets, but China completed a 25-21, 25-20, 25-22 sweep on Monday at Park Arena Komaki. Alas is already out of the medal race with a 0-2 record in Pool D and relegated to the classification round despite having one final pool-stage game against […]...
